grounded.title: Answers come from your data, never from guesswork.
grounded.body: Prices, free slots and policies are looked up live. A booking is only confirmed after your database accepts it.
grounded.stepAsk: Is there time for balayage on Thursday evening?
grounded.stepReply: Thursday at 5:00 PM with James is free. Shall I book it?
grounded.stepConfirm: Booked for Thursday, 5:00 PM. Your reference is 7F3A91C2.
grounded.guard: Two bookings can never overlap for the same person. The database rejects it, so the assistant can't promise a taken slot.

items.q: Does it use my own WhatsApp number?
items.a: Yes. Each business connects its own WhatsApp Business number through Meta's official WhatsApp Business Platform. Customers keep chatting with the number they already know.
Yes, in beta. The same assistant answers calls with the same services, prices and rules, and every call lands in your inbox as a transcript. You can try it in the browser on this page.

items.q: What happens when the assistant doesn't know something?
items.a: It never guesses. It tells the customer a team member will reply, flags the chat in your inbox and stops auto-replying until you hand it back.

items.q: Can customers pick a specific staff member?
items.a: Yes. The assistant only offers times when that person is working, free, and qualified for the service.
Every business's data is isolated at the database level with row-level security. WhatsApp access tokens are encrypted, and you can export your data at any time.
English, Turkish, Arabic, German, Spanish and many more. It always answers in the customer's language and understands regional dialects.

items.q: Can I control what it says?
items.a: Choose a tone, write a greeting and add your own instructions and FAQs. Prices, services and policies always come from what you set.
Most businesses are live the same day: connect your WhatsApp number, add services, staff and hours, and choose a tone.
